request.body: an MCP tools/list request (jsonrpc 2.0, empty params) sent as its own request: no credential, no Mcp-Session-Id header, and no initialize on this connection; section (P6) of the artifact, sent 18:10:26Z

decoded.tools: two, counted by occurrences of "inputSchema" over the whole 5,938-byte response: resolve-library-id (title Resolve Context7 Library ID) and query-docs (title Query Documentation), the same two as on 2026-09-23
decoded.challenge-header-absent: the 2026-09-23 reading of this request carried a WWW-Authenticate challenge on its 200 (Bearer, then resource_metadata naming https://mcp.context7.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource). This response carries NO www-authenticate header at all; the CORS Access-Control-Expose-Headers value still names WWW-Authenticate, so the server still expects to send one on some responses
decoded.statelessness: the server answered a tools/list that followed no handshake on this connection and issued no session id, as before
decoded.not-measured: whether a credentialed caller is listed more than these two tools, and on which responses the challenge is now sent
decoded.why-re-sent: Re-sent 2026-10-09 because the record of this request from 2026-09-23 (p-20260923-context7-mcp-tools-list-keyless) was filed before this prober kept transcripts and names no artifact; this one does. The tool list is unchanged; the challenge header is gone.

finding: Sent with no credential and no preceding handshake, tools/list still answers 200 and lists exactly two tools, resolve-library-id and query-docs, so Context7's keyless surface is what it was on 2026-09-23. One thing changed: the 2026-09-23 response carried a Bearer WWW-Authenticate challenge on its 200, naming the protected-resource metadata URL, and this one carries no such header, while the server's CORS exposure list still names WWW-Authenticate. A client that read the earlier challenge as an invitation to authenticate now gets no hint on this response. Which responses still carry the challenge, and whether the metadata document still answers, are not measured here; this record measures one listing and one header's absence on 2026-10-09.
